title: Financial Inclusion via Blockchain: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
authors: Shangrong Jiang; Yuze Li; Shouyang Wang
eligible_reason: Single-treated-unit, single-date DiD: Kiva loans/MFIs in Sierra Leone vs all other developing countries before/after the blockchain protocol launch (one common Post date). Every column in Tables 2-8 also includes time-varying borrower, MFI and country controls (YB IS RB ... Loan_ended Revenue Expense FID ... Literacy), and the specifications use a pooled Blockchain dummy with country FE (odd columns no FE). Not staggered, so not a near-miss.
design_notes: MS-FIN-2023-02303.do Table 2-6: reghdfe y Blockchain_Post Blockchain Post <controls> MFI Quarter/Year, absorb(Country) vce(cluster Country); boottest wild-cluster bootstrap. Individual.dta (5% subset): Blockchain x Post cells 2740/2328/1422/462; Post switches on at Quarter 27 for everyone.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Single treated country (Sierra Leone) and single implementation date of the Kiva blockchain protocol; Individual.dta: Post = 1 for Quarter >= 27 for all loans (treated and control).
data_files_note: README: Kiva Licensed API terms forbid sharing; authors ship a 'representative 5% subset' (Individual.dta 6,952 rows vs 186,325 in the full-sample log). No random sampling rule stated.
data_provenance_note: Small extract ('representative 5% subset') with no stated random sampling rule; counts as not_shipped under the Nov 1 rule.
screener_notes: Published PDF read (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2023.02303.pdf via data/text). Regression inventory was empty; do-file read directly.
